issues.where: shadowed B and A rings (crops E, G, I; also image-05.png, image-07.png crop Q, and point stars in image-02.png crop E)
issues.what: background stars and blurry orange skybox nebula patches shine undimmed straight through the optically thick B and A rings inside Saturn's shadow
issues.fix: compute ring occlusion from physical optical depth independently of direct sunlight so opaque ring bands block background stars and Milky Way emission even when unlit

issues.where: background sky across crops B, E, G, H, I (also image-05.png, image-07.png crops J, K, L, Q, and image-08.png crop W)
issues.what: the Milky Way skybox is low-resolution, stretched, and blurry, turning stars and clusters into large smeared orange-white blobs right beside crisp 1-pixel procedural star dots
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution equirectangular sky map with a native-resolution starfield and high-resolution deep-sky plate whose point-spread function matches the procedural stars

issues.where: lower-left sunlit limb and inner C/B rings in crop G (also image-03.png crop P, image-07.png crop O, image-01.png, and image-05.png)
issues.what: a detached warm glow halo sits outside Saturn's hard stair-stepped limb, and the outer boundary of the atmosphere shell forms a visible curved dark patch edge cutting across the inner rings
issues.fix: integrate volumetric atmospheric limb scattering smoothly across the planet boundary with continuous radial falloff to zero so no shell edge overlaps the rings

issues.where: globe silhouette and outer A/F ring edges in crops J, K, L, O (also image-02.png crops B, D, F, G and image-07.png crops J, K, N, O)
issues.what: 1-pixel stair-stepped aliasing runs along Saturn's sunlit and nightside limbs and the bright outer A-ring rim, the thin F ring breaks into dashed pixels, and steep concentric ringlets shimmer with pixel chatter
issues.fix: render with higher supersampling and anisotropic/MIP-filtered ring textures, and anti-alias planet and ring silhouettes before compositing glow

issues.where: upper-right moon in crop M (also image-07.png crop L, image-01.png, and image-05.png)
issues.what: the moon has a jagged stair-stepped sunlit edge with a bright 1-pixel doubled rim highlight instead of Titan's soft extended haze, and its surface shows airbrushed diagonal banding
issues.fix: anti-alias the moon geometry, replace the hard rim highlight with a multi-pixel scattering haze layer, and use a subtler, noise-dithered atmospheric gradient without linear bands

issues.where: north polar cap in crop L and mid-latitude bands in image-02.png crop A (also image-07.png crop K and image-06.png crop A)
issues.what: the blue north pole is soft and circular with noisy UV-pinched speckles at the pole center and lacks Saturn's hexagonal jet, while lower-latitude bands look slightly smooth and airbrushed
issues.fix: use a pole-safe spherical or cube-mapped cloud projection with higher polar texel density, include fine zonal cloud grain across all latitudes, and model the north polar hexagon

issues.where: right-hand sky in crops W and X and upper-left sky in image-03.png crop J (also image-01.png)
issues.what: artificial horizontal lens-flare streaks exhibit subtle gradient banding and are visibly clipped along a dark diagonal line by unlit outer ring-plane geometry past the sunlit ring tip in crop W
issues.fix: apply optical lens flare strictly in post-compositing with 16-bit dithering so unlit scene geometry cannot silhouette against camera-space streaks, or remove the artificial streaks

issues.where: right side, planet shadow on the rings
issues.what: the lit-to-shadow edge is a hard line only a couple of pixels wide, with almost no penumbra
issues.fix: widen and soften the falloff of the planet's shadow across the rings

issues.where: center panel E and lower right panel I, shadow edge
issues.what: at native size the boundary is a short ramp of about 2 to 6 pixels and reads as a stencil
issues.fix: give the umbra edge a wider solar penumbra so ring brightness falls off gradually

issues.where: lower left panel P, shadow across the rings
issues.what: the shadow edge is still a hard 1 to 2 pixel step at native size
issues.fix: soften that same shadow boundary; do not leave a knife edge

issues.where: upper right panel U, shadow crossing the ring arc
issues.what: the ramp is a little wider here but still only a few pixels, so the edge stays crisp
issues.fix: use the same wider penumbra on this stretch of the rings
